title: Koh Samet: follow the beach puppy
kaylee: Before: a 2 s beach name and a silent flag badge. After: a beach puppy runs ahead to a beach she hasn't played, waits and looks back, fetches her when she stands still, barks each beach's name, takes a shortcut with a sand slide, and hops in the taxi for far beaches. The top-left button calls him; home is the speedboat at the pier.
questions: Leaving Koh Samet only by the speedboat at the pier (tap it, then the home picture). OK?

links.label: Idle at Ao Phai: the puppy fetches her
